description: This weekend brought a pair of stories from either end of the spectrum. In the first, the Congressional primaries in New York City resulted in victories for 3 candidates endorsed by NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani. I support voters getting to choose who they want to represent them, and not surprisingly I believe a spectrum of inputs yields a better result.
